acceptable_use: Accessing the EHR and ticketing systems required for the assigned role
Screen auto-lock after five minutes of inactivity
Storing ePHI only in approved, encrypted network locations
prohibited_use: Accessing ePHI over untrusted or public Wi-Fi without the corporate VPN
Installing unapproved software or disabling endpoint agents
Copying ePHI to personal or removable media
approved_locations: Home offices meeting the remote-work security standard
